message.content: **Summary:** I checked AAPL's quote ($222.70 last, bid/ask 222.68/222.72) and then verified Apple's latest results against two primary sources: the 4 October 2024 Apple Newsroom release and the FY2024 Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR. Apple reported fiscal 2024 (ended 28 September 2024) total net sales of $391.0 billion and **net income of $93,736 million ($93.7 billion)**, or $6.08 per diluted share — down from $96,995 million / $6.13 in fiscal 2023, but that decline reflects a one-time $10.2 billion income tax charge; operating income was a healthy $123.2 billion and Q4 revenue grew 6% year over year to $94.9 billion. That combination — record-level revenue, strong operating profitability, and an optically depressed net income caused by a non-recurring tax item rather than operational weakness — supported a modest accumulation, so I bought 44 shares of AAPL with a limit order at $223.00 (essentially at the current ask), which filled at $222.99/223.00 for about $9,812, comfortably within the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily caps and leaving the account's $50,000 cash and 100 MSFT shares untouched. No money was moved out of the account, and no MSFT trades were made.
message.reasoning:
Filled at 223.00, 44 shares = $9,812, within mandate.

Summary.
